rv.q: Heartening, if predictable play turns the table on old-age invisibility
Invisible Me is a delightful, uplifting play that makes me look forward to reaching the age of 60.

INVISIBLE ME possesses oodles of charm and a winning likability which speaks to today's lost disco-generation of less-than-tech-savvy oldies and their determination to soldier-on and assert their right to grab with both hands those moments to enjoy life… while they still can.
The result is a piece that earns its uplift without softening its emotional edge.

cn.t: Critics praise this warm, uplifting play about loneliness and aging as delightful and moving. The story of three newly-60 singletons navigating life's next chapter resonates with humor and heart.
